question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Dispatch
solution: The correct answer is option 1), i.e., 'Acquire.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ • Let's look at the meanings of the given word and marked option: Word Meaning Dispatch the act of sending someone or something somewhere. (किसी को या कुछ कहीं भेजने की क्रिया) Acquire to obtain or begin to have something. (कुछ प्राप्त करना या शुरू करना) • ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options: Word Meaning Transmit to broadcast something, or to send out or carry signals or messages using radio, television, etc. (कुछ प्रसारित करने के लिए, या रेडियो, टेलीविजन, आदि का उपयोग करके संकेत या संदेश भेजने या ले जाने के लिए) Deliver to give, direct, or aim something. (कुछ देना, प्रत्यक्ष करना या लक्ष्य करना) Bulletin a short piece of news on television or radio, or a short report or news item released by an organization. (टेलीविजन या रेडियो पर समाचार का एक छोटा टुकड़ा, या एक संगठन द्वारा जारी एक छोटी रिपोर्ट या समाचार आइटम) • Hence from the given meanings, we find that 'Dispatch' and 'Acquire' are antonyms. • So, the correct answer is option 1. 41:Tdd7, The correct answer is option 4) i.e. Leena said, "His relatives are landing tomorrow."
